newsitem.title: USA: Access Health buys company, adds coverage.
newsitem.headline: Access Health buys company, adds coverage.

text.p: Access Health Inc on Wednesday announced one acquisition and two agreements that extend health coverage plans to some 800,000 members of managed care services in Minnesota and Arizona.

Access Health acquired privately-held Clinical Reference Systems Ltd, a developer of patient education and drug information software. Using the software, health providers can produce brochures on over 3,000 health topics and 6,000 drug products. Over 30,000 copies are in use in the United States.
Key software products include Adult Health Advisor, Pediatric Advisor and Women's Health Advisor.
Access Health also announced an agreement to provide its Personal Health Advisor information service to HealthPartners of Arizona Inc's 350,000 members over the next eight months.
Personal Health Advisor provides members with immediate access to health information and counseling services. Information is available 24 hours-a-day, seven days-a-week.

Lastly, the company's Information Access Systems unit will provide managed care services to over 450,000 members of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota's BlueChoice and Blue Plus health plans over the next six months.
Access Health stock was up 1-1/2 to 36-5/8 by mid-morning.
